title: Quasi-coherence over a quasi-coherent algebra agrees with quasi-coherence over the structure sheaf
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal A$ a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebras whose underlying $\mathcal O_S$-module is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. An *$\mathcal A$-module* is a sheaf of $\mathcal A$-modules on $S$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; it is an $\mathcal O_S$-module through the structure map $\mathcal O_S\to\mathcal A$. An $\mathcal A$-module $\mathcal G$ is *quasi-coherent as an $\mathcal A$-module* if every point of $S$ has an open neighbourhood $W$ with an exact sequence $\bigoplus_{j\in J}\mathcal A|_W\to\bigoplus_{i\in I}\mathcal A|_W\to\mathcal G|_W\to0$ of $\mathcal A|_W$-modules, for some sets $I,J$ (direct sums taken in the category of $\mathcal A|_W$-modules). Then an $\mathcal A$-module $\mathcal G$ is quasi-coherent as an $\mathcal A$-module if and only if its underlying $\mathcal O_S$-module is quasi-coherent.

mathlib_searches.query: a module over a quasi-coherent algebra is quasi-coherent as module over the algebra iff quasi-coherent as module over the structure sheaf (restriction of scalars)
